description: This file is a shell script library for managing common merge tool functions within a Git environment. It provides functions to list, configure, validate, and run different merge and diff tools, as well as to handle tool selection logic and environment-specific configurations.

methods.name: mode_ok
methods.description: Checks if the current mode is either diff or merge and returns true if so.

methods.name: is_available
methods.description: Checks if a specified merge or diff tool is available in the environment.

methods.name: list_config_tools
methods.description: Lists configured tools from git config for a given section.

methods.name: show_tool_names
methods.description: Displays available tool names based on a condition, supports various display options.

methods.name: diff_mode
methods.description: Returns true if the current tool mode is diff.

methods.name: merge_mode
methods.description: Returns true if the current tool mode is merge.

methods.name: get_gui_default
methods.description: Determines the default GUI setting based on environment and configuration.

methods.name: gui_mode
methods.description: Checks if the GUI mode is enabled for merge tools.

methods.name: translate_merge_tool_path
methods.description: Returns the path to a merge tool, defaulting to the input.

methods.name: check_unchanged
methods.description: Verifies whether the merged file is unchanged or prompts the user to confirm success.

methods.name: valid_tool
methods.description: Validates whether a given merge or diff tool is recognized and functional.

methods.name: setup_user_tool
methods.description: Configures user-defined tools with command evaluation.

methods.name: setup_tool
methods.description: Initializes a tool's environment, setting up command functions and validation.

methods.name: get_merge_tool_cmd
methods.description: Retrieves the command for a specified merge or diff tool.

methods.name: trust_exit_code
methods.description: Determines if the exit code from a tool can be trusted.

methods.name: initialize_merge_tool
methods.description: Sets up the merge tool environment by calling setup_tool.

methods.name: run_merge_tool
methods.description: Executes the merge or diff tool based on current mode.

methods.name: run_diff_cmd
methods.description: Runs the configured diff command for a tool.

methods.name: run_merge_cmd
methods.description: Runs the configured merge command, handling trust in exit code and post-merge checks.

methods.name: list_merge_tool_candidates
methods.description: Provides a list of candidate tools based on environment context for merging.

methods.name: show_tool_help
methods.description: Displays help information about available tools and configuration.

methods.name: guess_merge_tool
methods.description: Guesses an appropriate merge tool based on environment and availability.

methods.name: get_configured_merge_tool
methods.description: Retrieves the currently configured merge or diff tool from git config.

methods.name: get_merge_tool_path
methods.description: Resolves the system path to a merge tool executable.

methods.name: get_merge_tool
methods.description: Determines the merge tool to use, either configured or guessed.

methods.name: mergetool_find_win32_cmd
methods.description: Locates Windows-specific command for an executable, checking PATH and typical directories.
